name: poly-init-track-sidecars
description: After the stock track-directory helper returns newly-created (1), initialize polyA through polyX with 2176 zero bytes for melodic selectors 1..3. Drum selector 0 and existing/error directories are skipped. Checked directory creation initializes physical sidecars. The active-letter lifecycle supplies authoritative zero/silence before a first save and for missing native patterns. Replays original project accessor at 0x08024034. Scratch zero buffer 0x1000E500..0x1000ED7F, FIL 0x1000E000, count 0x1000E300, path 0x1000E400. CREATE_NEW avoids overwriting any existing sidecar.

patches.note: new track directory -> initialize zero sidecars, then stock project accessor
